data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to scan credit and debit cards offline using Google's ML models.
data.what_it_does: Opens the device camera to scan credit and debit cards completely offline. Extracts card numbers, expiry dates, card holder names, and card issuers using Google's machine learning models.
use_when: You need to allow users to scan credit or debit cards using the camera.
Scanning must be done completely offline for security purposes.
avoid_when: You require payment processing capabilities rather than just card data scanning.
You need custom UI overlays that the plugin does not support.
strengths: Can scan expiry dates, card holder names, and card issuers alongside card numbers
weaknesses: Requires modifying iOS Podfile (commenting out use_frameworks!)
GPL-3.0 license may restrict usage in proprietary projects
data.setup_notes: For iOS, set the minimum target to >= 15.0 and comment out the use_frameworks! line in the Podfile.
